description: This file contains C source code implementing JSON parsing, environment variable management, and JSON data extraction functions including file reading, JSON object querying, and string handling. It also includes utility functions for writing JSON key-value pairs to files or environment variables.

methods.name: int writeItemVal(FILE * fpout,char * pName,char * pVal,int setenvvars)
methods.description: Writes a JSON 'name=value' pair to an output file and optionally sets environment variables.

methods.name: void convertInvalidChars(char * pStr)
methods.description: Converts invalid characters in environment variable names to underscores.

methods.name: size_t getitemval(cJSON * pcitem,char * pOut,size_t szpOutSize)
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a JSON item as a string.

methods.name: int SetJsonVars(char * fileIn,char * fileOut,int setenvvars)
methods.description: Reads a JSON file and writes key-value pairs to an output file and/or sets environment variables.

methods.name: JSON * ParseJsonStr(char * pJsonStr)
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JSON object.

methods.name: int FreeJson(JSON * pJson)
methods.description: Frees a JSON object created by ParseJsonStr.

methods.name: JSON * GetJsonItem(JSON * pJson,char * pValToGet)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific item from a JSON object by name.

methods.name: size_t GetJsonValFromString(char * pJsonStr,char * pValToGet,char * pOutputVal,size_t maxlen)
methods.description: Extracts a JSON value as a string given a JSON string and a key.

methods.name: size_t GetJsonVal(JSON * pJson,char * pValToGet,char * pOutputVal,size_t maxlen)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific value from a JSON object by key.

methods.name: size_t GetJsonValContainingFromString(char * pJsonStr,char * pValToGet,char * pOutputVal,size_t maxlen)
methods.description: Searches a JSON string for keys containing the given substring and returns associated values.

methods.name: size_t GetJsonValContaining(JSON * pJson,char * pValToGet,char * pOutputVal,size_t maxlen)
methods.description: Searches within a JSON object for keys that contain the given substring and returns associated data.

methods.name: char * GetJson(char * filename_in)
methods.description: Reads a JSON file into a dynamically allocated string.

methods.name: bool IsJsonArray(JSON * pJson)
methods.description: Checks if a JSON object is an array.

methods.name: unsigned GetJsonArraySize(JSON * pJson)
methods.description: Returns the size of a JSON array.

methods.name: JSON * GetJsonArrayItem(JSON * pJson,unsigned index)
methods.description: Returns an item from a JSON array by index.

methods.name: int (*)(FILE * fpout,char * pName,char * pVal,int setenvvars) getwriteItemVal(void)
